```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data_path <- "/Users/wangjueying/Documents/uiuc CATS lab/data analysis/data_corrected.csv"

raw <- read.csv(
  data_path,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dim(raw)
```

```{r}
question_text <- raw[1, ]

dat <- raw[-1, ]

dim(dat)
dat[dat == ""] <- NA
```

```{r}
vignette_vars <- grep(
  "^V[1-5]Q",
  names(dat),
  value = TRUE
)

length(vignette_vars)
```

```{r}
numeric_vars <- c(
  "Progress",
  "Duration (in seconds)",
  "Finished",
  "Q63",
  vignette_vars,
  "Dem3",
  "Dem5",
  "Dem8",
  "Dem9",
  "Dem10",
  "Dem11",
  "Dem12"
)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(numeric_vars),
      as.numeric
    )
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(20240711)

dat$participant_id <- sample(
  100000:999999,
  nrow(dat),
  replace = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
nrow(dat)
length(unique(dat$participant_id))
anyDuplicated(dat$participant_id)
```

```{r}
table(dat$Q63, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    flag_no_consent = is.na(Q63) | Q63 != 1
  )
table(dat$flag_no_consent)
```

```{r}
table(dat$Finished, useNA = "ifany")
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    flag_unfinished = is.na(Finished) | Finished != 1
  )
```

```{r}
table(dat$Dem5, useNA = "ifany")
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    attention_status = case_when(
      is.na(Dem5) ~ "Missing / not reached",
      Dem5 == 4 ~ "Passed",
      TRUE ~ "Failed"
    )
  )
```
```{r}
table(dat$attention_status, useNA = "ifany")
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    flag_attention_failed = attention_status == "Failed"
  )
```

```{r}
for (v in 1:5) {

  vars_v <- grep(
    paste0("^V", v, "Q"),
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  dat[[paste0("V", v, "_n_answered")]] <-
    rowSums(!is.na(dat[, vars_v, drop = FALSE]))
}
```

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    n_vignettes_with_data =
      (V1_n_answered > 0) +
      (V2_n_answered > 0) +
      (V3_n_answered > 0) +
      (V4_n_answered > 0) +
      (V5_n_answered > 0)
  )
```

```{r}
table(dat$n_vignettes_with_data)
```

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    has_any_vignette_data = n_vignettes_with_data > 0,
    flag_no_vignette_data = n_vignettes_with_data == 0
  )
table(dat$flag_no_vignette_data)
```

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    V1_has_data = V1_n_answered > 0,
    V2_has_data = V2_n_answered > 0,
    V3_has_data = V3_n_answered > 0,
    V4_has_data = V4_n_answered > 0,
    V5_has_data = V5_n_answered > 0
  )
```

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    n_vignette_items_missing =
      rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(vignette_vars)))),

    prop_vignette_items_missing =
      n_vignette_items_missing / length(vignette_vars)
  )
```

```{r}
quality_review <- dat %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    Q63,
    flag_no_consent,
    Finished,
    Progress,
    flag_unfinished,
    attention_status,
    flag_attention_failed,
    V1_n_answered,
    V2_n_answered,
    V3_n_answered,
    V4_n_answered,
    V5_n_answered,
    n_vignettes_with_data,
    n_vignette_items_missing,
    prop_vignette_items_missing
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(flag_no_consent),
    desc(flag_attention_failed),
    desc(flag_unfinished)
  )

quality_review
```
```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    eligible_for_analysis =
      !flag_no_consent &
      has_any_vignette_data
  )
table(dat$eligible_for_analysis)
```

```{r}
dat %>%
  filter(flag_unfinished) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    Progress,
    attention_status,
    V1_n_answered,
    V2_n_answered,
    V3_n_answered,
    V4_n_answered,
    V5_n_answered,
    n_vignettes_with_data
  )
```


```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    gender_text = Dem2 %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_to_lower(),

    gender = case_when(
      gender_text %in% c(
        "woman",
        "women",
        "female"
      ) ~ "Woman",

      gender_text %in% c(
        "man",
        "male",
        "trans man"
      ) ~ "Man",

      gender_text == "nonbinary" ~ "Nonbinary",

      is.na(gender_text) ~ NA_character_,

      TRUE ~ "Other / review"
    )
  )

table(dat$gender, useNA = "ifany")
gender_summary <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(gender)) %>%
  count(gender) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100
  )

gender_summary
```
```{r}
dat %>%
  filter(gender_text == "trans man") %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    Dem2,
    gender,
    Dem3
  )
```

```{r}
      )
```

```{r}
table(dat$Dem4, useNA = "ifany")
selected_option <- function(x, code) {
  str_detect(
    paste0(",", x, ","),
    paste0(",", code, ",")
  )
}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    sexual_asexual      = selected_option(Dem4, 1),
    sexual_gay          = selected_option(Dem4, 2),
    sexual_lesbian      = selected_option(Dem4, 3),
    sexual_queer        = selected_option(Dem4, 4),
    sexual_bisexual     = selected_option(Dem4, 5),
    sexual_pansexual    = selected_option(Dem4, 6),
    sexual_straight     = selected_option(Dem4, 7),
    sexual_prefer_no    = selected_option(Dem4, 8),
    sexual_other        = selected_option(Dem4, 9),
    sexual_gynosexual   = selected_option(Dem4, 10),
    sexual_androsexual  = selected_option(Dem4, 11),
    sexual_demisexual   = selected_option(Dem4, 12),
    sexual_graysexual   = selected_option(Dem4, 13)
  )
sexual_vars <- c(
  "sexual_asexual",
  "sexual_gay",
  "sexual_lesbian",
  "sexual_queer",
  "sexual_bisexual",
  "sexual_pansexual",
  "sexual_straight",
  "sexual_prefer_no",
  "sexual_other",
  "sexual_gynosexual",
  "sexual_androsexual",
  "sexual_demisexual",
  "sexual_graysexual"
)

dat[is.na(dat$Dem4), sexual_vars] <- NA
sexual_orientation_summary <- tibble(
  category = c(
    "Asexual",
    "Gay",
    "Lesbian",
    "Queer",
    "Bisexual",
    "Pansexual",
    "Straight/heterosexual",
    "Prefer not to answer",
    "Something else",
    "Gynosexual",
    "Androsexual",
    "Demisexual",
    "Gray-sexual"
  ),
  n = sapply(
    dat[sexual_vars],
    function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(!is.na(dat$Dem4)) * 100
  )

sexual_orientation_summary
```

```{r}
long_dat <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^V[1-5]Q"),
    names_to = c("vignette", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^V([1-5])(Q[1-4]_[0-9]+)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vignette = factor(
      vignette,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5")
    )
  )
names_to = c("vignette", ".value")
```

```{r}
dim(long_dat)
table(long_dat$vignette)
long_dat %>%
  count(participant_id) %>%
  count(n)

```

```{r}
outcome_vars <- grep(
  "^Q[1-4]_",
  names(long_dat),
  value = TRUE
)

length(outcome_vars)
```

```{r}
table(
  sub("_.*", "", outcome_vars)
)
```

```{r}
long_dat <- long_dat %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_items_answered = sum(
      !is.na(c_across(all_of(outcome_vars)))
    ),

    vignette_has_data = n_items_answered > 0
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
table(long_dat$vignette_has_data)
```

```{r}
long_dat %>%
  filter(!vignette_has_data) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    vignette,
    Finished,
    Progress,
    attention_status,
    n_items_answered
  )
```

```{r}
  )
```
